name: correct
description: Fix something FRED got wrong in memory: either a person's name (wrong name and right name), or a remembered item (which one, and what it should say). Asks the user to confirm first.

wrong.description: for a name fix: the wrong name

right.description: for a name fix: the right name

item.description: for an item fix: its number or a few words from it

text.description: for an item fix: what it should say instead, in the user's words

examples: my sister is Nitya, not Navya
that's wrong, I wake up at seven, not six
no, his name is Rohan not Rohit
correct that: I study chemistry on fridays
you got that wrong about my favourite food
not_for: correcting the user's spelling or grammar
